name: When should a med spa start investing in Answer Engine Optimization?

mainEntity.name: When should a med spa start investing in Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A med spa should consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization as soon as possible, especially if they already have an established online presence or are launching a new one. With the increasing reliance on voice search and AI-powered answers, early adoption ensures your med spa gains a competitive edge. It's particularly beneficial when local searches for med spa services are prevalent, as AEO can position your business as the go-to answer for nearby queries. Starting early allows for data collection and refinement of your AEO strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: A med spa should invest in AEO as soon as possible, especially with an existing online presence or launch. Early adoption provides a competitive edge in voice and AI-powered search.
